tool.name: RFEM Thermal Solver
tool.description: Solve steady-state diffusion/thermal with per-element random material field

param.name: fix_file
param.label: Fixed freedoms (.fix)
param.help: Shared BC file from RFEM BC Generator

tool.help:
Solves the 3D steady-state diffusion (Fick's law) or heat conduction (Fourier's law) equation with spatially varying per-element material properties.
Inputs: - Instance archive: contains mesh (.d), control (.dat), and material file (.mat) for a single Monte Carlo realisation — generated by RFEM Field Generator - Fixed freedoms (.fix): Dirichlet BCs from RFEM BC Generator, shared by all instances
Physics: ∇·(D∇C) = 0 or ∇·(k∇T) = 0 Solver: Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (PCG), element-by-element assembly Elements: 8-node hexahedra, nodof=1
Output: - .res: convergence summary (iteration count, timing) - .ensi.tar.gz: EnSight Gold scalar NDPTL field for ParaView visualisation
For Monte Carlo UQ: run this tool once per random field realisation (map-over a collection of instance archives), then aggregate with RFEM Aggregation tool.
